title: Calisthenics and weights PPL
author: Stefan Petrov
desc:
This is a novice/intermediate training program

3 days on, 1 day off, repeat for max gains.

ex.note: Can be substituted with ring flys
Cable kickback, not dumbbells, cables keep tension
3-6 sets, check the website “50 pull ups” for ideas on sets and reps, don’t just do 3x8, push yourself
Working lats and mid back, this exercise can be skipped if you feel you’ve achieved necessary effort from normal pull ups
Working the Brachialis
This can be substituted with barbell curl, preacher curls and barbell curls are shown to stimulate the biceps the most (from the info I have gathered at least)
Substitute with squat if you wish

Working lower back and hamstrings with this one
You can add weight - take a barbell and put it behind the neck, the way you’d position it for a back squat. Don’t hold a plate in front of you.
Can be substituted with a machine crunch.
